title: Uranium Glass
content_md: In blog post “ Quickpost: Uranium Glass ” I show some spectra made with the Radiacode app. I just discovered that this app also allows you to compare and subtract spectra. Here I subtracted the background spectrum from the uranium glass spectrum: It’s easier to see the uranium peaks in this spectrum. Article Link: Update: Uranium Glass | Didier Stevens
exclude_reason: Quickpost about Radiacode spectra of uranium glass, not a security event, vulnerability, attack, breach or advisory.
